name: @downshift/desktop
description: Downshift for Windows: the Downshift app in an Electron window with a tray icon showing live heart rate
author: Eli Gorelick

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir dist --target node --external electron --format cjs
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run --cwd ../app build && electron .
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run --cwd ../app build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
